description.value: Siegel's Bagels is an iconic Kitsilano bakery producing authentic Montreal-style bagels baked throughout the day in a wood-fired oven, situated just blocks from Kits Beach on the Cornwall Avenue cycling route. The extensive menu spans a dozen bagel flavours, breakfast sandwiches, Montreal smoked meat imported fresh weekly, and a wide selection of cream cheeses. A second outpost inside Granville Island Public Market makes it a natural fuelling stop on two of Vancouver's most-cycled urban corridors.

The site prominently advertises 'In-store Pick-up' as a primary ordering mode, and the menu explicitly lists 'Dairy-Free Cream Cheese' alongside many meatless items, supporting a vegetarian/vegan-friendly designation. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site.
